orderingDevices.note: Book headings/colophons are part of the text (e.g. prathamaṃ kāṇḍam).
ABCH is divided by kāṇḍa; varga-level labels occur only in the tiryak-kāṇḍa and the avyaya-varga.
tiryak-kāṇḍa carries a third kvvv tier (e.g. pañcendriya → sthalacara).
Verse-end numbers '.. N ..' (half-verse '(N)'); numbering runs on continuously across all 14 section boundaries.
<eid> segmentation of a verse into sets is editorial annotation, not marked in the verse itself.
Per-lexeme liṅga tags are annotator-supplied; the text marks gender by form, association and explicit statement.
0.6667 of multi-gender sets keep each gender in one run vs 0.6212 expected by chance.
avyaya-varga is the last section of the digitization, a top-level division after the sāmānya-kāṇḍa.
Adjacent-headword non-decreasing share 0.4993 in synonymic sections — chance level, i.e. no alphabetical device.
